_comment: Copy to mini-electron.json and edit. Place next to the exe (or in the working dir), or point MINI_ELECTRON_CONFIG at it. Unknown keys are ignored.
name: Mini Electron Demo

sign._comment: exe code signing, mirrors electron-builder. enabled (or CSC_LINK env) triggers signing; WIN_CSC_LINK/WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD/CSC_LINK/CSC_KEY_PASSWORD also work. Default dual-signs sha1+sha256.
